answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the grove of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The voyage is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the tundra. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
